request.query: Finite sum of terms bounded above by B is at most cardinality times B

items.name: Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_1 : PartialOrder N] [AddLeftMono N] (s : Finset ι)
  (f : ι → N) (n : N), (∀ x ∈ s, f x ≤ n) → s.sum f ≤ s.card • n

items.name: Cardinal.sum_le_iSup
items.type: ∀ {ι : Type u} (f : ι → Cardinal.{u}), Cardinal.sum f ≤ Cardinal.mk ι * ⨆ i, f i

items.name: Finset.sum_card_le
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq α] {B : Finset (Finset α)} {n : ℕ} [inst_1 : Fintype α],
  (∀ (a : α), {b ∈ B | a ∈ b}.card ≤ n) → ∑ s ∈ B, s.card ≤ Fintype.card α * n

items.name: Multiset.sum_le_card_nsmul
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : PartialOrder α] [AddLeftMono α] (s : Multiset α) (n : α),
  (∀ (x : α), x ∈ s → x ≤ n) → s.sum ≤ s.card • n

items.name: Finset.card_nsmul_le_sum
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_1 : PartialOrder N] [AddLeftMono N] (s : Finset ι)
  (f : ι → N) (n : N), (∀ x ∈ s, n ≤ f x) → s.card • n ≤ s.sum f
